summary: In August 2025 in Lipa City, Batangas, Jericho Elliorante, 25, newly crowned winner of an LGBTQ pageant in Barangay Sambat, Tanauan City, was found dead with 13 stab wounds. Police opened a homicide case within days of the crowning — a faster institutional response than the unresolved General Santos shooting of the activist in Soccsksargen — but the killing is one of six in the 2024-2025 national series, and the 13-wound severity and LGBTQ-pageant context mark it as trans-implicated violence. The region has no protective ordinance cluster documented.
